text: Torrent search will share the same search bar with the streaming search.
There will be a tick box to allow the user to choose to include torrent searching in the search.
Results will be arranged in size/date/alphabetical order by clicking on the column headers.
There will be a tick box to allow the user to choose to include video link searching in the search.
The software will use hyperlinks to allow the user to open websites in their default web browser.
Query times will take no longer than 5 seconds to any website.
